Name: AT - Cool Character Plushies
Author: miahxd
Description:
[b]Now with 2 options of slim or chubby plushies! [/b] The new slim plushies are less round than the original design. Some plushies you may notice are a bit taller to accentuate the height differences between some of the characters. You can choose whichever style fits your preferences (you can also download both if you'd like more options)!

This is my first mod so sorry for the lack of professionalism. Feel free to suggest other characters you'd like to see or even variations of those already in the mod. As of now, I've only included characters from shows I've seen but I'm open to do more if I have time!
